subject: Oceanography
title: Submarine Canyons
description: A quick win: understand Submarine Canyons.

hook.text: The Monterey Canyon is as deep and wide as the Grand Canyon—but carved into the continental shelf offshore.

buildup.text: Submarine canyons cut through continental slopes—carved by turbidity currents and sediment flows.

discovery.text: Turbidity currents are underwater avalanches of sediment—racing downslope at over 60 km/h.

twist.text: In 1929, a turbidity current snapped undersea telegraph cables—scientists measured its speed from the timing.

climax.text: Canyons funnel nutrients from the shelf to the deep—supporting dense communities of corals and fish.

punchline.text: The ocean hides canyons that rival anything on land.
